notes:
Short-hand CRM notes and call highlights:
- Account background: Lumen Shift Ops provides cloud contact-center orchestration used by retail and telco customers. Currently outsourcing NLU to two vendors; wants single inference layer to standardize agent-assist and summaries.
- Expansion driver: success on small pilot for ticket summarization; now aiming to expand to live agent-assist + outbound tool-calling across 3 new teams (revenue ops, fraud, returns).
- Quote from Mira Kato (VP Product): "We need deterministic behavior during sale spikes — can't have agents blocked waiting for responses. Also need provable audit trail for every outbound write."
- Latency/throughput targets: target 50-200ms median for suggestive snippets, p95 < 2s for short replies, sustain 8k concurrent agent sessions with support for 20k burst.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget but tight margins; must show Optimize savings >25% to justify Dedicated commitment.
- Model preferences: prefer open quantized models with fallback to smaller variants for cost control; require reranking layer for legal/compliance content.
- Reliability requirements: automatic fallback to cached answers + regional model fallback; explicit degrade-to-text-only mode if downstream tool-calls fail.
- Security: SSO/SAML mandatory; KMS integration required for on-prem keys; full audit logs for every tool-call and model output; retention controls per customer.
- POC observations: summarization quality high for transactional tickets; contextual agent-assist needs more conversational state handling; tool-call flows need helper for idempotency tokens.
- Sales notes: good upsell path to Private deployment for regulated telco customers and to Redwood Optimize for cost savings. SE to map batching params and prefix caching gains specific to Lumen's ticket patterns.
- Blockers and asks: legal wants explicit DPA clause about model telemetry; infra asks for runbook for APAC failover; product asks for sample reranking policies to reduce hallucinations in compliance language.
- Next actions (choppy): deliver stress test report by 2026-02-24; send APAC data residency whitepaper; update SOW with idempotency SLA; schedule legal touchpoint 2026-03-04.
